name: shiny-button
blurb: Bright shine effect sweeps across on hover.
description: A button with a white shine overlay that slides across from left to right on hover, creating a glossy effect.
use_when: You want a polished, high-touch CTA that reacts to hover.
avoid_when: On touch-only interfaces where hover does not apply.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Shine effect is visual feedback only.
